independence_evidence: The Walrus is published by The Walrus Foundation, a registered charitable non-profit based in Toronto (Wikipedia; the publisher's own store says purchases support fact-based journalism at The Walrus), with no media-group owner.
qualifies_reason: Charity-published Canadian general-interest magazine issuing eight print issues a year, with a November 2026 issue indexed on its own site.
what_it_is: A Canadian general-interest magazine of long-form journalism, essays, fiction and poetry, covering national politics, culture, science and social issues from a Canadian vantage point, with illustrated covers commissioned from artists. It appears eight times a year in print (some issues combined, such as January/February) alongside a large online operation, podcasts and a national talks series. It is for readers who want in-depth Canadian current-affairs and cultural writing.
uncertainties: thewalrus.ca (including its feed and WP JSON API) is behind a Cloudflare JavaScript challenge and returned 403 to every fetch attempt, so the publisher's main site could not be read; the November 2026 issue is known only from a web-search result pointing to the site's own November 2026 issue category page, and publisher details (Walrus Foundation, Toronto, eight issues a year) come from Wikipedia and the store's subscription listing ('eight compelling issues' a year, CAD 35). No current single-issue cover price was found: the publisher's Shopify store sells back issues at CAD 10 but lists nothing newer than March/April 2025. Frequency is recorded as irregular only because the brief's fixed list has no eight-a-year option; the actual schedule is eight issues a year. No image of the November 2026 cover could be retrieved; the store's newest cover file is March/April 2025. Trim size and page count are not stated.
